neighbours.label: the word that introduces a superlative ('the' or 'most' right before a superlative or ranking like 'the most', 'the second largest')
fire: Many climbers say that K2 is the most dangerous mountain in the world.
The cheetah is widely regarded as the fastest animal on land.
Venice remains one of the most visited cities in all of Italy.
The blue whale is considered the largest animal that has ever lived.
For many readers it is the best novel the author ever wrote.
Tokyo is often called the most crowded metropolitan area on Earth.
The Amazon is the second longest river after the Nile.
Critics called the bridge the most beautiful structure of the decade.
quiet: Many climbers say that K2 is a dangerous mountain to attempt in winter.
The cheetah is a fast animal that hunts on the open plains.
Venice is a city of canals that many tourists visit in summer.
The blue whale is a huge animal that feeds mainly on krill.
For many readers it is a moving novel about family and loss.
Tokyo is a crowded metropolitan area with a famous subway system.
The Amazon is a long river that flows through several countries.
Critics called the bridge a beautiful structure with elegant arches.

notes: Card: peaks on ' the' x12 / ' most' x5 / ' first' / ' second' in 'remains the most mysterious', 'one of the 20th century's great', 'considered the most active', 'the second most diverse'. Near misses describe the same things with plain adjectives, no ranking.
